This is a hybrid role based in the Mexico City office. Coordinate with Field Marketing Managers to track budgets, purchase requests, vendor invoices, and program spend in partnership with Finance

About the job

About Turn




Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.





About the Role




We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.




You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.




What You’ll Do





Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).


Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.


Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.


Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.


Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).


Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.









What You’ll Need





Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.


Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.


Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).


Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).


CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.


A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.


Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.









This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.




Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)





Growth in qualified demos and marketing-sourced pipeline, at flat or lower cost per acquisition.


Higher conversion rates across the funnel, from visitor to demo to booked meeting.


A larger share of best-fit (ICP) traffic reached and converted.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for an Online Media Manager that owns the planning, supports execution, optimization and measurement of digital media campaigns across our business.

This role will translate campaign briefs and business objectives into actionable digital media plans, working closely with Channel Managers, Marketing teams, Creative teams, Analytics and our media agency.

You will be responsible for ensuring campaigns are properly planned, implemented, monitored and optimized, while turning campaign performance into clear insights and learnings that can improve future media decisions.

About the job

Ubicación:

Guadalajara, Jalisco, México.

Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de una persona responsable, comprometida, con ganas de aprender y desarrollarse en el área de Marketing. Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí.

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com.

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

About the job

Job Title: Data Scientist

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid

This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Data Scientists are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing data science team and will conduct innovative machine learning research and build product feature prototypes that will deliver value to our customers.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for solving business problems using our in-house data and your technical prowess. Specifically, you will:


Apply advanced statistical techniques and concepts to analyze data from the company databases and other unstructured data sources to build innovative product features, marketing content, and internal services.
Invest in the sales engagement domain; collaborate with product, engineering, sales, customer success, and other teams to understand business and customer needs, and translate them to tangible data science problems.
Own and manage complex projects and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
Contribute to the rapid growth of the research organization, being flexible in data engineering, algorithmist, and analyst responsibilities as they arise.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to build revolutionary AI and ML systems that are changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a results-oriented, deeply curious, and strategic researcher who is passionate about owning their work and its impact. You are a leader and mentor who thrives on identifying gaps in knowledge and charting new paths for innovation. Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us push the boundaries of what's possible in AI for sales by taking ownership of complex projects and seeing them through to completion.

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Scientist is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Salesloft Data Science team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming Data Scientists.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Data Science team consists of collaborative and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about their craft. We operate in a dynamic environment where our project timelines more closely align with engineering sprints than academic papers. We value intellectual curiosity and encourage researchers to voice feedback and help prioritize projects that will have the biggest impact.

THE SKILL SET:


2+ years of experience as an AI Researcher, Data Scientist, or ML Engineer.
Experience delivering components of research projects, from experimental design to implementing models.
Strong proficiency in AI agent systems, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and classic machine learning methodologies.
A collaborative spirit with a passion for sharing knowledge with your peers.
Experience turning research findings into actionable insights for technical partners.
Excellent communication skills; you must be able to articulate complex technical concepts
familiarity with python for data processing, ML, AI agents
familiarity with frameworks for agentic AI (LangGraph, Google ADK, Open AI Agents SDK etc)

Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Strong businesses are built on strong support teams. At Arrow, our Business Support professionals help drive operational excellence by connecting people, improving processes, and enabling collaboration across our global organization.

Whether you're supporting business operations, coordinating projects, or helping teams work more efficiently, you'll contribute to continuous improvement, deliver exceptional service, and help build a more agile, connected, and innovative business.

About Arrow

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better.

At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges.

Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.

Responsibilities and more:

Junior Construction Project Coordinator & Estimator




Location: Remote – Latin America

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Industry: Residential Construction & Remodeling

Salary: $1050 - $1700 per month




Position Overview:

Our client, an established and expanding residential construction and remodeling company serving the Tampa Bay area, is seeking a meticulous and highly motivated Junior Construction Project Coordinator & Estimator for this entry-level career opportunity. This role is strategically designed for an emerging professional seeking to cultivate a long-term career within the industry through comprehensive,

hands-on training across all facets of residential construction estimating, material costs, and profit margins. As the candidate develops technical proficiency, demonstrates consistent analytical accuracy, and exhibits operational independence, both professional responsibilities and financial compensation will scale accordingly. Operating in collaboration with field contractors, the Junior Estimator will review measurements,

photographic evidence, field notes, and scopes of work compiled during onsite customer consultations to synthesize professional, comprehensive project estimates. Professional fluency in written English and conversational proficiency in spoken English (B2+

level or higher) are mandatory requirements for regular corporate communications.




Key Responsibilities

• Review measurements, photos, contractor notes, and project requirements following onsite appointments.

• Prepare detailed estimates and customer quotes for residential remodeling and construction projects.

• Calculate projected labor, material, subcontractor, and other project costs.

• Coordinate with field contractors and operations to clarify missing or unclear information and ensure estimates accurately reflect the proposed work.

• Update estimates and price change orders when project scope, materials, or customer requirements change.

• Maintain accurate, organized pricing, project details, and estimating records.




Required Qualifications

• Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic cost calculations.

• Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with U.S.-based contractors and leadership.

• Availability to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

• Strong numerical, analytical, and attention-to-detail skills.

• Comfortable with basic project-management, and working in CRM platforms.

• Comfortable working in imperial units (ft/in, sq ft, linear ft).

• Ability to interpret measurements, project notes, photos, and construction-related documentation.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple estimates simultaneously.




Nice-to-haves

• Previous experience in residential construction, remodeling, restoration, general contracting, or a related industry.

• Understanding of construction materials, labor requirements, subcontractor costs, and project margins.

• Familiarity using Monday.com and/or construction estimating or quoting software.

• Familiarity with U.S. construction practices and working with contractors.

• Familiarity with U.S. material pricing (e.g., Home Depot, Lowe's, local suppliers).




What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will consistently turn field information into accurate, timely, and easy-to-understand estimates, typically delivered within 24–48 hours of the site visit, allowing the field team to spend less time on administrative quoting and more time managing customers and projects.




Accuracy is critical. The Estimator must be comfortable asking questions when information is incomplete rather than making assumptions that could affect project cost or profitability.

title: Sales & Data ambassador
description:
About the job

Position

Moët Hennessy is looking for a Sales Ambassador – Off Trade based in Mexico City, responsible for driving sales growth, developing and strengthening strategic relationships with key retail customers, and ensuring excellent commercial execution across the Off Trade channel.

This role combines strong commercial capabilities with a data-driven mindset, leveraging sales analytics, business intelligence tools, and market insights to identify growth opportunities, optimize customer performance, and support strategic decision-making. The Sales Ambassador will play a key role in managing customer performance through KPI analysis, forecasting, business reviews, and commercial planning, while maintaining close relationships with retail buyers and ensuring execution aligned with the company's luxury standards.

The position requires a balance between office-based analytical work and regular customer/store visits within Mexico City to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and ensure the successful execution of commercial initiatives

Job Responsibilities

Commercial Management

Develop and execute commercial plans aligned with sales objectives for assigned Off Trade accounts. Drive sales growth and achieve commercial targets through effective account management, assortment optimization, and customer development. Build, manage, and strengthen strategic relationships with key retail customers, distributors, buyers, and decision-makers. Lead commercial negotiations, ensuring profitable agreements, promotional compliance, and alignment with company objectives and brand standards. Identify new business opportunities to increase sales, distribution, visibility, and market share within the retail landscape. Conduct regular customer visits and store checks to review business performance, identify opportunities, and strengthen partnerships. Ensure excellent in-store execution, including visibility, shelf presence, secondary placement, promotional initiatives, and brand standards.

Business Analysis & Data Management

Monitor and analyze sales performance, sell-in, sell-out, depletion, inventory levels, and customer KPIs to identify opportunities and risks. Extract, consolidate, and analyze commercial data from SAP, internal systems, and external data sources (e.g., market research and retail panel data). Develop, maintain, and improve reporting dashboards and scorecards using Power BI and advanced Excel tools. Generate actionable insights through data analysis to support commercial strategies, category performance, and customer development plans. Lead sales forecasting and support demand planning activities through data-driven analysis. Analyze customer profitability, product mix performance, pricing opportunities, and market trends. Prepare monthly business reviews, commercial performance reports, and executive presentations. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all sales reporting processes. Support management decision-making through ad hoc analysis and business recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Trade Marketing, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams. Support annual planning cycles, budget reviews, and commercial initiatives with analytical insights. Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and business performance tracking. Contribute to Commercial Excellence initiatives through data analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance management

Profile

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, International Business, or a related field.

Experience

2 to 4 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Excellence, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, Revenue Management, or related commercial roles. Experience within FMCG, premium beverages, consumer goods, luxury brands, retail, or related industries is preferred. Proven experience managing retail customer relationships and delivering commercial results. Strong experience in sales reporting, forecasting, KPI management, and performance analysis. Experience working with distributors and Off Trade / retail customers is highly desirable. Experience using ERP systems, preferably SAP. Demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

Technical Skills

Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced formulas, dashboards, scenario analysis). Advanced Power BI (data modeling, dashboard creation, KPI tracking, visualization, and reporting). SAP knowledge and experience in sales reporting, customer performance analysis, and commercial data management. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities. Advanced English.

Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical mindset and business acumen. Ability to transform data into strategic actions and business recommendations. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. Strong commercial and relationship management capabilities. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Results-oriented, proactive, and highly organized. Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills. Ability to influence stakeholders through insights and fact-based recommendations. Strong planning, prioritization, and project management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for luxury brands and exceptional consumer experiences.

Ideal Profile

A commercially driven professional with strong analytical capabilities who can successfully manage key Off Trade accounts while leveraging data, reporting, and business intelligence tools to drive growth, optimize retail performance, and support strategic decision-making.

About the job

Company Description

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the change to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch!

Job Description

The Supply Chain Planner — Customer & Procurement manages material flow across the North American supply chain on behalf of Bosch customers, plant operations, and internal logistics. Depending on business needs and team structure, this role may be assigned to one or both of the following tracks: Passthrough (Customer) Planning or Procurement (Raw Material) Planning. Planners are expected to develop competency in both areas over time, enabling organizational flexibility as business requirements evolve.

Assignment Note: Individual planners will be designated to a primary track based on team structure and business need. This JD covers both tracks to support role mobility and cross-training across the planning organization.

Track A: Customer & Passthrough Planning

Procure finished goods from global Bosch supplying plants → Manage warehouse inbound → Fulfill OEM/Tier 1 customer demand

A1. Inbound Planning & Procurement from Bosch Supplying Plants


Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.
Maintain 24+ months of rolling demand visibility in SAP and/or Kinaxis Maestro to support long-range capacity planning at supplying plants.
Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.


A2. Warehouse Coordination (Summerville, SC & Laredo, TX)


Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.


A3. Customer Management & Order Fulfillment


Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.


Track B: Procurement & Raw Material Planning

Translate production demand into supplier orders → Ensure uninterrupted material supply → Protect manufacturing continuity

B1. MRP-Driven Procurement Planning


Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.


B2. Supplier Coordination & Order Management


Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.


B3. Production Supply & Shortage Management


Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.


Applies to Both Tracks

Inventory Management & Optimization


Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting


Monitor and report KPIs relevant to assigned track: OTIF, backlog, premium freight, fill rate, supplier OTD, and DIO.
Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities across planning processes, system usage, and cross-functional workflows.


Qualifications

Required - All Planners


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.


Preferred - Track A (Passthrough / Customer Planning)


Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.


Preferred - Track B (Procurement / Raw Material Planning)


Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).

CPL consistently at or below target across all active accounts.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of hands-on Google Ads / PPC management experience (agency experience strongly preferred).

description:
About the job

Collective Residential is a property management platform built on a specific model: regional operators join a larger organization while retaining their brand, their team and their local decision-making. Collective Residential provides capital, technology, shared services and industry expertise. Operating companies retain their names and their people.

This is a technical, hands-on role responsible for establishing and enforcing digital marketing standards across our platform. While its scope is expected to grow as we consolidate our digital marketing ecosystem (future responsibilities are not yet fully defined), those are some of the main responsibilities:

Digital audit & SOPs: Audit website, SEO, AEO/GEO, paid media, email, organic social, reputation and listings across six operating companies and the corporate brand, then build formal portfolio-wide SOPs.

Paid media at scale: Own Google and Meta campaigns end to end at the property and corporate level. This may mean hundreds of concurrent campaigns, with hands-on management of spend, duration and performance in compliance with Fair Housing advertising requirements.

Budget guidance: Serve as the go-to advisor for VPs of Marketing and Marketing Managers on which levers to pull and at what spend, backed by data.

SEO, AEO & GEO: Lead technical and on-page SEO and ongoing optimization for AI answer and generative search platforms as search evolves.

Performance reporting: Build and own unified reporting that rolls up from Collective to portfolio company to property level, plus periodic competitive benchmarking.

PropTech & AI: Bring PropTech experience and ideas for integrating AI tools into team workflows and into how the tech stack shapes the customer journey.

Account consolidation: Migrate digital marketing accounts and platforms, including relevant property management and CRM access, into a centralized, company-owned structure. Scope expands as this matures.

Websites: Own website strategy and execution across all portfolio company sites. Support the CMO-led corporate redesign with UX input, and own connecting campaigns to the site after launch.

Email: Own corporate email strategy and execution, and set the standard for portfolio companies.

Organic social: Set portfolio-wide strategy and standards, partnering with the portfolio teams who produce the content.

Reputation: Optimize Google Business Profiles and manage online reputation across all six operating companies.

ILS data: Coordinate with Marketing Managers, who own listing content, to ensure accurate data and reporting from ILS and syndication platforms such as Apartments.com, Zillow Rental Manager, and RentCafe.

Vendor accountability: Hold every web, SEO, paid-media, email, reputation, and listing vendor to a defined standard.



Requirements


Deep, cross-channel digital expertise, our top qualification with 6-8+ years of technical experience.
An analytical, systems mindset and strong funnel understanding.
Hands-on CRM experience and general familiarity with property management systems.
End-to-end Google and Meta management at property and corporate scale, with hundreds of concurrent campaigns.
Advanced technical SEO plus current AEO/GEO experience.
Experience with multi-level reporting, PropTech, and AI integration.
Website/UX design, email, organic social, GBP and reputation management, and ILS coordination.
Knowledge of Fair Housing ad rules, including Meta's Special Ad Category.
A track record with SOPs, account consolidation, and vendor management.
Helpful, not required: Multifamily, hospitality, or home sales marketing. Brand website redesign or multi-brand agency experience.


Benefits


Flexible schedule.
Payment in USD - contractor agreement.

About the job

Ubicación:

Guadalajara, Jalisco, México.

Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

Este puesto tiene como objetivo brindar soporte en la gestión de marca y en la ejecución de estrategias de marketing y comunicación, participando activamente en la implementación de planes, campañas y activaciones en distintos canales de distribución.

Si tienes un perfil apasionado por el análisis de mercado, el Marketing y la generación de insights a través de la interpretación de datos ¡te estamos buscando!

Principales Responsabilidades:

Apoyarás en el desarrollo e implementación de planes de marketing y comunicación.

Darás seguimiento a materiales promocionales, activaciones y campañas en los diferentes canales de distribución.

Apoyarás en la recolección y organización de información de ventas, competencia, consumidor y tendencias.

Brindarás soporte en la comunicación con agencias creativas, de medios y promociones.

Monitorearás métricas básicas y apoyarás en la generación de contenidos.

Acerca de ti:


Estudiantes activos de Licenciatura, a partir de 5to. semestre (garantizar estatus activo de al menos un año y/o no tener más de 6 meses de egreso). 
Formación académica en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación o afines. 
Inglés nivel Avanzado Conversacional.

Interés por aprender y desarrollarse en el área, en un entorno dinámico: desde la parte analítica, interpretación de data y generación de insights.


Nuestros Beneficios y ventajas:

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí.

Acerca de Ferrero:

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com.

¿Cómo ser exitoso en el rol y en Ferrero?

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

DE&I en Ferrero:

Ferrero se compromete a construir una cultura diversa e inclusiva donde todos los empleados se sientan bienvenidos, valorados y tengan las mismas oportunidades.  Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to a culture of learning and knowledge sharing.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Solid previous professional software development experience.

title: Consumer Insights Manager // AI & Market Research
description:
About the job

Consumer Insights Manager | AI & Market Research




Mexico City | Hybrid | Full-time




Salary: MXN $75,000–$100,000 gross/month + performance bonus + private medical insurance + statutory and above-statutory benefits




The opportunity

We are recruiting for a successful international AI company that is expanding into Latin America and opening its operations in Mexico.

The company develops technology that helps organizations understand and simulate consumer behavior using AI, first-party data and advanced research methodologies. Its platform allows companies to test concepts, messages, pricing and campaigns faster while maintaining strong methodological and statistical rigor.

Mexico will be a key market for the company's regional expansion, and this position will be one of the first strategic hires in the country.




The role

We are looking for an experienced Consumer Insights / Market Research professional who can work directly with clients and turn research questions into actionable business decisions.

This is not a sales role and it is not a pure account-management position.

We are looking for someone who understands quantitative market research, can confidently discuss methodology with clients, and knows how to translate data into clear recommendations for Marketing, Innovation, Insights and senior management.

You will combine traditional research expertise with AI-powered tools and synthetic consumer data.




What you will do

* Work directly with clients to understand their business and research questions.

* Design quantitative research studies, questionnaires, segments and sampling approaches.

* Design and execute client pilots using an AI-powered research platform.

* Analyze study results and turn them into clear business insights and recommendations.

* Present findings and defend research methodology with senior clients.

* Train Marketing, Insights and Innovation teams to use the platform effectively.

* Support demonstrations and help identify relevant research use cases.

* Help clients adopt the platform and become increasingly self-sufficient.

* Work closely with global Research, Product and Data teams.

* Turn successful studies into reusable methodologies and templates.




What we are looking for

* 4–7 years of experience in Consumer Insights or Market Research.

* Experience at a recognized research agency or within a Consumer / Market Intelligence function.

* Strong quantitative research skills, including questionnaire design, segmentation, weighting and statistical significance.

* Experience presenting research findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

* Ability to explain complex research concepts clearly to non-researchers.

* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.

* Strong practical use of AI tools in your daily work.

* Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and helping build a new operation from the ground up.




Particularly relevant backgrounds

Experience at companies such as Kantar, Ipsos, NIQ/Nielsen, Circana, Brain, De la Riva, Provokers or similar, or within Consumer Insights / Market Intelligence teams at large consumer companies.




Nice to have

* Experience in CPG, retail or beauty.

* Experience within a corporate Consumer Insights or Market Intelligence team.

* Exposure to synthetic data or AI-driven research tools.




Why this opportunity is different

This is not a replacement hire or a mature corporate role.

You will join an international technology company at the beginning of its Mexico expansion and will have significant exposure to clients, the global team and the development of the company's business in Latin America.

description:
About the job

¿QUIÉN ES HOLCIM?

Somos el líder en construcción sostenible, con ventas netas de CHF 16.2 mil millones¹ en 2024, generando valor en todo el entorno de la construcción, desde infraestructura e industria hasta edificaciones y vivienda. Con sede en Zug, Suiza, contamos con más de 45,000 colaboradores en 44 mercados atractivos en Europa, Latinoamérica, Asia, Medio Oriente y África, que viven nuestro propósito de construir progreso para las personas y el planeta.




Holcim ofrece materiales y soluciones integrales de alto valor para la construcción, que abarcan desde cimentaciones y pisos hasta techos y muros, impulsadas por marcas premium como ECOPlanet, ECOPact y ECOCycle®.




Para obtener más información, visita www.holcim.com.mx




ÚNETE A HOLCIM Y CONSTRUYE PROGRESO PARA LAS PERSONAS Y EL PLANETA

En Holcim, el crecimiento comienza con las personas. Nos esforzamos por ser el mejor lugar para trabajar, donde se fomenta el talento, las personas están comprometidas y la salud y la seguridad son la máxima prioridad.




Ese compromiso ha sido reconocido por el Top Employers Institute: Holcim fue certificada como uno de los mejores empleadores a nivel global, en Latinoamérica obtuvimos la certificación regional, reafirmando la excelencia de nuestras prácticas de personas y nuestro enfoque en el desarrollo de nuestros equipos.




Así es como vivimos nuestra cultura Holcim Spirit, enfocada en el propósito, las personas y el performance, para acelerar la construcción sostenible.




TE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO: Coordinación Sales Excellence




Serás responsable de diseñar, implementar y dar seguimiento a iniciativas que impulsen la excelencia comercial del equipo de ventas, alineadas con la estrategia del negocio. A través de los pilares de estructura comercial, productividad y capacitación, contribuirás al cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales, potenciando la captación de nuevos clientes, la recuperación de clientes, el cross selling y el crecimiento en nuevas categorías.

Purpose of the Job

The Data Analyst will be responsible for leading cross-functional reporting and campaign performance data aggregation across all partner and brand initiatives. In this role, you will pull and consolidate metrics from internal manager data exports and partner-facing platforms to build comprehensive post-mortem summaries and automated dashboards. You will be tasked with translating raw execution data into highly polished, executive-ready business reviews that track Return on Investment (ROI) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance. This analytical role requires a detail-oriented professional who can transform complex datasets into clear, actionable commercial insights for leadership teams.

This will be a hybrid position based in company’s and client offices in Mexico City. This role will be required to be in office 2-3 days per week, with the ability to work from home the remaining days.

Key Responsibilities


Aggregate and synthesize performance metrics across disparate partner channels, localized brand campaigns, and external retail footprints. 
Extract, clean, and consolidate marketing data utilizing direct data exports from internal managers and self-serve partner-facing platform metrics.

Knowledge, Skills + Experience


4–6 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Analyst, or Business Intelligence Analyst—specifically working with multi-channel marketing campaigns, agency networks, or tech sector accounts.
